reason: The cash-drawer check and cancelled-bill report are exactly what I worry about when I'm away, but I already run billing on an app and moving 5 to 10 staff and all my customer data to something new is a headache I don't want this month. The rest, WhatsApp bills, reminders, wallet, I mostly have already.
objection: Why switch? My staff already know the current app, and I don't know who you are or whether you'll still be around in a year with my customer list in your system.
would_change_my_mind: If you moved my existing customer data and wallet balances over for free and let me run the cash and staff checks for a full month alongside my current app, and it caught real leakage, I would switch.
